name: How to Stop an AI Agent Stuck in an Infinite Loop
title: How to Stop an AI Agent Stuck in an Infinite Loop
summary: An AI agent gets stuck in an infinite loop when a model keeps calling a tool that fails, usually with the same arguments, because nothing in the agent loop tells it to stop. Each retry resends the whole conversation, so every turn costs more than the last, and a loop left running overnight can cost thousands of dollars.
